def transform2(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        color=grid[r][c]
        if color==bg: continue
        for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
          prev=(r-dr,c-dc)
          if 0<=prev[0]<h and 0<=prev[1]<w and grid[prev[0]][prev[1]]==color: continue
          cells=[]; y,x=r,c
          while 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w and grid[y][x]==color:
            cells.append((y,x)); y+=dr; x+=dc
          if len(cells)<2: continue
          a,b=cells[0],cells[-1]
          if any(rr in (0,h-1) or cc in (0,w-1) for rr,cc in (a,b)): continue
          for (y,x,sy,sx) in ((a[0]-dr,a[1]-dc,-dr,-dc),(b[0]+dr,b[1]+dc,dr,dc)):
            while 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w and grid[y][x]==bg:
              out[y][x]=color; y+=sy; x+=sx
    return out
